text:
marie: Quick heads-up — NebulaWorks case study + webinar planning. Need: launch post, short benchmark narrative, customer quote cleared by legal, and webinar registration page + slides. Goal: publish week of May 12. Draft doc: https://docs.redwood.com/nebulaworks-case-draft :point_right:

kofi: Thanks. Who's owning the slide deck / webinar ops?

lina: I can take slides & speaker runbook. I'll need the final 1-liner from Alex and the benchmark callouts by Wed EOD.

raj: Can someone confirm which benchmark numbers we're allowed to publish? we have the 2x throughput numbers but also a 25% cost reduction stat — need legal ok on claims.

priya: Lead routing question — after webinar, we want to route MQLs to growth@redwood and tag utm_campaign=nebulaworks_launch. Sam, can you confirm SDR handoff?

sam (growth): Yep — SDR queue configured. Please add this to the registration form: company size, cloud provider, and interest (hosted/dedicated/private). We'll set priority for enterprise signals. utm params noted.

alex (NebulaWorks): Happy to provide a quote. Draft: "Redwood cut inference costs for our chatbot by about 25% while keeping p99 latency under 150ms — game changer for production." LMK if you want tighter wording.

lina: That one-liner reads well. We'll need legal clearance on the exact numbers. Also Alex — would you be willing to be a webinar speaker for a 20-min customer segment + 10-min Q&A?

alex (NebulaWorks): Yes, can do. Prefer Wed or Thu afternoons PST.

legal-bot: NebulaWorks quote flagged for verification. Please submit the quote and benchmark sources to legal-review queue using the template: 
```
- quote_text: "..."
- metric_sources: [benchmark-run-id, internal-report link]
- embargo_date: yyyy-mm-dd
```
Submit to: https://legal.redwood.com/review (choose "marketing: customer quotes").

marie: I uploaded a press draft excerpt to the doc and added a section with benchmark context. Excerpt: 
"NebulaWorks saw ~2x throughput in our latency-sensitive pipeline and ~25% lower token cost after adopting Redwood batching + KV cache."
kofi: +1. For the launch post, can we get a short customer video clip (30s) highlighting the cost/latency win? good for socials. @alex — is that possible?

alex (NebulaWorks): Yes, we can record a short clip. I'll ask our engineering lead to join.

raj: FYI — PMs need to sign off on any product claims by Tue. I flagged the draft to product for callouts.

priya: Webinar ops checklist: registration page, speakers, slide deck, promo cadence, email templates, SDR mapping, and post-event content (blog + one-pager). Who owns promo cadence?

marie: I'll own promo cadence + launch post copy. Lina handles slides + webinar ops. Raj will get product signoff. Kofi to coordinate video snippet. Priya owns post-event assets and lead routing. Legal-bot: please advise on turnaround time for quote approval.

legal-bot: Standard SLA is 3 business days for quote + metric verification if all sources are attached. If there are redlines, add 2 days. Recommend submitting by Tue morning to hit May 12 launch.

lina: Noted. I'll draft slides this afternoon and drop a speaker runbook in the doc. Need headshot + short bio from Alex.

sam (growth): Also add a quick question on the registration form: "Are you evaluating inference infrastructure in next 6 months?" — helps prioritization.

marie: Timeline check: submit quote/materials to legal by Tue AM, product signoff Tue EOD, final slides + speaker confirm Wed EOD, recording Wed/Thu, publish post and run webinar week of May 12. Does that timeline work for everyone? :calendar:

kofi: Works for me.

raj: I'll review product claims Mon afternoon.

priya: Backfill email templates by Tue.

alex (NebulaWorks): We'll aim to have quote + headshot to you by Tue morning.

marie: Perfect — thanks all. I'll ping reminders tomorrow. :thumbsup:
